title: helm-private-values-init-hooks-kms-compatibility-and-schema-tighten
author: Ava Chen
ci_status: pass (failed helm-template on first run, fixed and rerun)
description: Motivation: Customers running Redwood Private with KMS-backed encryption reported upgrade failures when the chart allowed optional KMS fields to be present but not fully populated. This PR tightens the values schema for the private chart, improves templating guards around KMS and node-affinity fields, and introduces init hooks to safely migrate existing installations during chart upgrades. Summary of changes: 1) values.schema.json: tighten validation for .encryption.kms (require structure if encryption.enabled=true) and add clear deprecation fields for legacy config. 2) templates/init-job-secret.yaml: add a pre-upgrade initJob hook that conditionally creates missing KMS secrets for clusters where encryption.enabled=true but kms.* fields were previously empty. The job is annotated as a canary and uses ownerReferences=false to allow safe rollback. 3) templates/init-hooks.yaml: stabilize hook ordering with explicit weights and add readiness checks before marking upgrade complete. 4) templates/secret-generator.tpl: fix templating nil checks for nested maps (nodeSelector, tolerations, kms) to avoid template render panics in Helm v3.11. 5) Chart.yaml/README.md: document upgrade path, rollback notes, and required Linear/Jira tickets for enterprise upgrades. Testing and verification: local helm template, chart linting, unit tests for schema validation, and a canary upgrade in our perf-canary cluster. Observed behavior: initial helm-template CI failed due to an unguarded .nodeSelector access; fixed in second commit. Compatibility: migration job is a no-op when encryption.enabled=false; schema changes are backward compatible for charts < v3.6 except when users rely on malformed kms config, for which we provide the migration job and instructions. Rollout notes: this PR should be deployed with a canary to a single tenant before fleet-wide rollout. Backout: removing the chart version will not delete customer secrets created by the migration job; documented manual cleanup steps are included.

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Please confirm upgrade/rollback semantics — if the migration job creates secrets, will rollback remove them? We should document and provide a manual cleanup script.
Ava Chen: Good catch. The migration job intentionally avoids ownerReferences so rollback won't auto-delete secrets; added cleanup steps to README and a helper script in docs/cleanup.md.
Priya Nambiar: Can we make the initJob idempotent and also limit it to a single replica? Also add a 30s backoff and explicit readiness probe.
Ava Chen: Updated job to single replica, added idempotency (check before create), and readiness probe + backoff in latest commit.
Liam O'Connor: CI failed on helm-template run — looks like an unguarded .nodeSelector access. After the templating fix and tests, LGTM.
Diego Martinez: Approved after docs and tests added. +1 for canary rollout guidance.
